description.value: Miion Café is an artisan coffee shop in Richmond, BC, whose name and identity are built around the chemistry concept of ions — the idea that a cup of coffee can trigger a transformative 'ionic state' of energy or inspiration. Founded by owner Mia, it serves a full espresso bar alongside stone-milled teas and a food menu of house-baked croissants, bagel sandwiches, salads, and fruit bowls. The café also runs latte art workshops, giving it a community hub quality beyond a standard coffee stop.
